statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has symptom reporting coded as R00.2 and R42
Mobile cardiac telemetry service (CPT 93229) was ordered for this patient
The clinical purpose of the service is to assess for rhythm disturbances contributing to the patient's presentation
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
